name: AMS
recent: AMS Advanced Material Berhad 近期以 RM550,000 收购了子公司 AMS Aluprecision 剩余 10% 股权，使其成为全资子公司。董事总经理 Keh Teng Yang 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。公司最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM38.9 million，净利 RM118,000。
notable: 公司以 RM550,000 现金收购 AMS Aluprecision 剩余 10% 股权，交易完成后该公司成为全资子公司。
董事总经理 Keh Teng Yang 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次增持公司股份。

recent_en: AMS Advanced Material Berhad recently acquired the remaining 10% stake in subsidiary AMS Aluprecision for RM550,000, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Managing Director Keh Teng Yang has been acquiring shares in the open market multiple times between September and November 2026. The company's latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) reported revenue of RM38.9 million and net profit of RM118,000.
notable_en: The company acquired the remaining 10% stake in AMS Aluprecision for RM550,000 cash, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary upon completion.
Managing Director Keh Teng Yang acquired shares in the company multiple times between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM38,901,000 and net profit was RM118,000, with a net margin of 0.3%.
